name: Integra contextual niche presets
description: Migrated, source-attributed local design presets. Matches are advisory candidates, not global design mandates.

provenance.policy: Preserve principles and reference cues; never copy protected layouts, copy, assets or brand identity.

selectionPolicy: Score explicit niche terms deterministically. Treat matches as candidates; validate them against brief facts, hard constraints and existing product identity.

principles: Foreground the product, its origin, process, and specific sensory details.
Use warm negative space and restrained editorial storytelling; show real product or producer imagery.

sources.name: Blue Bottle Coffee
patternCues: Quiet composition and deliberate product photography

sources.name: Onyx Coffee Lab
patternCues: Packaging and product as strong visual anchors

principles: Keep copy calm and concise with generous whitespace and tactile, truthful imagery.
Use credible product or care details instead of generic health claims or decorative icon overload.

sources.name: Headspace
patternCues: Consistent, calm illustration and content hierarchy

principles: Let consistent product photography and useful product details lead.
Make price, materials, fit, and care easy to scan; keep promotion secondary.

sources.name: Glossier
patternCues: Clear paths between editorial content and shopping

principles: Show the working product, a credible workflow, or code instead of abstract technology imagery.
Use distinct feature hierarchy and concrete evidence; avoid interchangeable feature cards and ornamental gradients.
Make fees, security, eligibility, and next steps explicit and easy to compare.
Use restrained color, legible data displays, and substantiated trust signals.

sources.name: Stripe
patternCues: Product evidence paired with concise copy

sources.name: Ramp
patternCues: Finance workflows presented as measurable outcomes

principles: Put useful search controls first and keep the initial form to a few meaningful fields.
Make listing imagery, location, price, and verification cues easy to compare.

sources.name: Airbnb
patternCues: Large listing photography and scannable details

principles: Prioritize typographic hierarchy, useful metadata, and a deliberate reading or project index.
Use real work, authorship, and publication details rather than generic card grids.

sources.name: Awwwards
patternCues: Portfolio navigation and varied project presentation

principles: Tornar tangível a atividade da comunidade: canais, eventos, níveis, contadores.
Cor de marca quente sobre fundo petróleo; mascote/personagem próprio. Evitar roxo/neon e estética corporativa fria.
Let authentic work photography, booking details, and strong type establish the character.
Use high contrast and a restrained accent; avoid corporate blue, generic gradients, and overly rounded controls.

sources.name: Fontsinuse
patternCues: Typography research by context and medium

principles: Use bold flat color, visible structure, and strong typography with restraint.
Explain utility and risk plainly; avoid implying returns or using decorative motion that obscures content.

sources.name: Neobrutalism
patternCues: Hard edges and direct visual hierarchy

principles: Use authentic atmosphere imagery and concise sensory copy.
Keep menu or offering, opening hours, location, and reservation path easy to find.
A embalagem é o herói: em escala, reconhecível, cortada pela margem; texto mínimo.
Sabor/variante muda a cor do produto, não a paleta inteira da UI. Declarar números e avisos legais com unidade ligada.

sources.name: Poppi
patternCues: Produto repetido em escala e ritmo

dossier: Bebidas e embalagem de consumo (energéticos, refrigerantes)

principles: Especificações, medidas e diagramas como conteúdo principal; monoespaçada para dados.
Grelha visível e hierarquia técnica; evitar imagens de stock genéricas.
Marcação, horários, morada e especialidades visíveis sem scroll.
Linguagem clara, sem promessas de cura; credenciais verificáveis.
